All schools in this illustration pay annually upfront. Commission applies to new eligible referrals in their first 12 paid months. Payment cost is an assumption, not a provider tariff. Delivery cost covers core hosting/support; separately funded provider usage and setup fees are excluded. Contribution is before fixed overhead, tax and incremental acquisition spend.

Size a planning budget — not a confirmed ask

Allocation: 40% product/reliability, 25% onboarding/distribution, 20% customer success, 15% security/infrastructure. A real application needs a costed budget and founder approval.

Explore a pupil-price example

Reference term bands: first 150 at ₦500, next 350 at ₦450, next 1,000 at ₦400, next 1,500 at ₦350. Minimum ₦30,000 / four-month term. Above 3,000: custom quote.
